name: hotel-booking-dynamodb
description: Quản lý đặt phòng khách sạn — Amazon DynamoDB single-table design

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.ddb:local: docker run -d --name dynamodb-local-data -p 8001:8000 -v hotel-dynamodb-data:/home/dynamodblocal/data --restart unless-stopped amazon/dynamodb-local -jar DynamoDBLocal.jar -sharedDb -dbPath ./data
